question: The plasma concentration of a drug in the steady state is:

options.opa: The range of plasma concentration achieved with a drug after five half-lives have elapsed.
options.opb: The maximum expected plasma level with a drug in chronic treatment.
options.opc: The area under the curve produced by any dose in the course of a chronic treatment.
options.opd: The molar equivalent to the elimination half-life.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Drug administration -> drug absorption -> drug distribution -> drug metabolism -> drug elimination -> steady-state plasma concentration: opa. The range of plasma concentration achieved with a drug after five half-lives have elapsed. -> 95%

CHAIN: Drug administration -> drug absorption -> drug distribution -> drug metabolism -> drug elimination -> steady-state plasma concentration: opb. The maximum expected plasma level with a drug in chronic treatment. -> 90%

CHAIN: Drug administration -> drug absorption -> drug distribution -> drug metabolism -> drug elimination -> steady-state plasma concentration: opc. The area under the curve produced by any dose in the course of a chronic treatment. -> 80%

CHAIN: Drug administration -> drug absorption -> drug distribution -> drug metabolism -> drug elimination -> steady-state plasma concentration: opd. The molar equivalent to the elimination half-life. -> 70%
